WoW: Forever

Demonology Warlock

Your demon fights alongside you and your own damage keeps it alive. In Forever, demons scale with your gear.

WoW: Forever · Ranged DPS · Updated October 8, 2026 · Beta build 1.60.1.70245 · Null Ossuary

Levelling guide, 1 to 60. The beta is capped at level 30 as of the October 1 build, which Blizzard raised from 20 that day, so no level-60 Demonology build has been tested. No source has posted a level 30 build either: the cap only reached 30 on October 1, and none of the three has published one since. The level 30 line below therefore extends the published level 20 build using the full talent tree's point costs — not a build any guide has recommended.

What Demonology is for

Demonic EnergiesDemonic EnergiesTalentCastInstantYou heal your pet for 15% of all spell damage you deal. When you gain Mana from Life Tap, your summoned demon gains 100% of the Mana you gain.: your damage heals the demon, and Life TapLife TapSpell · Physical · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantDurationUntil cancelledReduces health cost of your Life Tap by 12%. feeds its mana. At 2/2, 15% of all your spell damage is mirrored to your pet as healing, and 100% of the mana from a Life Tap goes to it too. The thing absorbing the hits is topped up by casting you were doing anyway.

"Demonology is an excellent solo leveler because your demon can take a lot of pressure off you while you cast from range." Icy Veins rates its levelling 5 out of 5, joint best in the class.

CorruptionCorruptionLevel 4 · Spell · Shadow · Rank 1 of 7Cast2 sec castCost35 ManaRange30 yd rangeDuration12 secCorrupts the target, causing 40 Shadow damage over 12 sec. keeps its cast time here. In the source's own words: "Unlike Affliction, this build does not take Improved CorruptionImproved CorruptionTalentCastInstantReduces the casting time of your Corruption spell by 2 sec and increases the damage it deals by 10%., so CorruptionCorruptionLevel 4 · Spell · Shadow · Rank 1 of 7Cast2 sec castCost35 ManaRange30 yd rangeDuration12 secCorrupts the target, causing 40 Shadow damage over 12 sec. still has a cast time." That means "setting up multiple enemies takes longer than it does for Affliction."

The Legacy System adds points beyond these 11. Wowhead puts the cap at 7 legacy points from world exploration before level 25, worth 2 extra talent points. Its top pick there is Improved SayaadImproved SayaadTalentCastInstantIncreases the effect of your Succubus' and Incubus' Lash of Pain and Soothing Kiss spells by 30%, and increases the duration of your Succubus' and Incubus' Seduction and Lesser Invisibility spells by 30%., "the strongest per point benefit" for Succubus damage; it calls Demonic SacrificeDemonic SacrificeSpell · ShadowCastInstantRange100 yd rangeWhen activated, sacrifices your summoned Demon to enhance the opposing aspect of your power, granting you an effect that lasts 7200 sec. Felhunter: Restores 3% of your total Health every 4 sec. "likely not worth it due to losing out on your pet's DPS" this early. Those points cannot be spent at 20 as printed. Blizzard's Known Issues list opening the Legacy System before level 25 as a bug: the “Y” hotkey works but throws LUA errors on tabs 1 and 3. Read these as what to spend Legacy points on from 25, not as part of a level-20 build.

Rotation

Icy Veins and Wowhead order the opening DoTs differently, same as the other two specs.

Icy Veins' order is Immolate, then Corruption, then Bane of Agony.

Wowhead reverses it: "Bane of Agony first: it deals the least upfront damage, so it's the least threat and requires time to build up to full damage. Immolate last; its initial Hit generates direct threat, so it's the worst opener."

  1. Send the demon in: "Your demon should be attacking throughout the entire fight"
  2. Curse
  3. ImmolateImmolateSpell · Fire · Rank 1 of 8CastInstantCost25 ManaRange30 yd rangeDuration21 secBurns an enemy, then inflicts additional Fire damage every 3 sec. for 21 sec.: or last, on Wowhead's threat-ordered build, see above

This damage is dealt slowly at first, and builds up as the Bane reaches its full duration. Only one Bane per Warlock can be active on any one target. if the target will live long enough: or first, on Wowhead's build

Stat priority

Spell Power, then Hit, Intellect, Spirit, critical strike, Stamina, Haste.

Same order as Affliction, with different reasoning at two places. Spell Power because "More spell damage also means more healing for your demon through Demonic EnergiesDemonic EnergiesTalentCastInstantYou heal your pet for 15% of all spell damage you deal. When you gain Mana from Life Tap, your summoned demon gains 100% of the Mana you gain.." Hit is flagged harder: "This build does not take SuppressionSuppressionTalentCastInstantImproves your chance to hit by 5% and reduces all threat you generate by 20%., so you do not have the additional Hit Chance from the Affliction tree." Intellect is lifted by Fel VitalityFel VitalityTalentCastInstantIncreases the maximum health and Mana of your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, and Felhunter by 15%, and increases your maximum Mana by 15%.'s +15% maximum mana. Spirit costs you nothing to carry now: Demonic EmbraceDemonic EmbraceTalentCastInstantIncreases your total Stamina by 15%. no longer reduces it, and Life TapLife TapSpell · Physical · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantDurationUntil cancelledReduces health cost of your Life Tap by 12%. scales off it.

What Forever changed for Demonology

  • Demons now scale with your gear, confirmed by Blizzard as a baseline change: "Pets now scale from their summoner's stats." A guide's hands-on reading of it: they "deal much more damage and become much tankier."
  • Eight new talents: Demonic AegisDemonic AegisTalentCastInstantDuration12 secIncreases the effectiveness of your Demon Skin and Demon Armor spells by 30%. (up to +30% to Demon Skin and Demon Armor), Fel VitalityFel VitalityTalentCastInstantIncreases the maximum health and Mana of your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, and Felhunter by 15%, and increases your maximum Mana by 15%., Demonic EnergiesDemonic EnergiesTalentCastInstantYou heal your pet for 15% of all spell damage you deal. When you gain Mana from Life Tap, your summoned demon gains 100% of the Mana you gain., DecimationDecimationTalentCastInstant, Demonic BrandDemonic BrandTalentCastInstantRange100 yd rangeConsuming a brand deals 1 Physical damage., Improved FelhunterImproved FelhunterTalentCastInstantIncreases the Attack Power reduction of your Felhunter's Tainted Blood, the healing of its Devour Magic, and the detection level of its Paranoia by 30%, and reduces the cooldown of its Spell Lock by 6 sec., Demonic KnowledgeDemonic KnowledgeTalentCastInstantIncreases your spell damage and your Demon pet's spell damage by up to 100% of your level while you have a summoned Demon pet active., and the capstone Demonic PactDemonic PactTalentCastInstantYour Demonic Sacrifice effect is no longer cancelled by summoning a different Demon pet. Resummoning the sacrificed pet will still cancel the effect.: "Your Demonic SacrificeDemonic SacrificeSpell · ShadowCastInstantRange100 yd rangeWhen activated, sacrifices your summoned Demon to enhance the opposing aspect of your power, granting you an effect that lasts 7200 sec. The effect is canceled if any Demon is summoned. Imp: Increases your Shadow damage by 15%. Voidwalker: Restores 2% of your total Mana every 4 sec. Succubus/Incubus: Increases your Fire damage by 15%. Felhunter: Restores 3% of your total Health every 4 sec. effect is no longer cancelled by summoning a different Demon pet. Resummoning the sacrificed pet will still cancel the effect." So you keep the sacrifice buff and a demon, just not the one you sacrificed. It requires Soul LinkSoul LinkLevel 40 · Spell · ShadowCastInstantRange100 yd rangeWhen active, 30% of all damage taken by the caster is taken by your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, or Felhunter Demon instead. In addition, both the Demon and the master will inflict 3% more damage. Lasts as long as the Demon is active. and sits at 31 points, so the published reaction, "At last, we can play with our pet out instead of sacrificing it", is to a tooltip nobody has reached.

At level 60

Unknown, and the gap is pet scaling: "Pet balance is one of the clearest areas to watch during beta… Demonology is much more dependent on its active pet than it was in original Classic", and nobody has established how your stats convert into demon output.

Sources

Compiled from the three major Forever guide sites and cross-checked against each other. Where Blizzard has published an official class deep dive, that post outranks all three and the page is written from it. Everything else — talent ranks, tooltip values, what exists in the tree at all — is settled against the client itself, read through foreverchanges.pro and wago.tools. Where the guides disagree with each other, this page says which said what.
